combat the prohibitive communication costs of ``free-for-all\" multi-agent systems (MAS), we introduce \\textbf{Agent-GSPO}, a framework that directly optimizes for token economy using sequence-level reinforcement learning. Agent-GSPO leverages the stable and memory-efficient Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) algorithm to train agents on a communication-aware reward that explicitly penalizes verbosity. Across seven reasoning benchmarks, Agent-GSPO not only achieves new state-of-the-art performance but does so with a fraction of the token consumption of existing methods. By fostering emergent strategies like ``strategic silence,\" our approach provides a practical blueprint for developing scalable and economically viable multi-agent systems.","descriptionType":"Abstract"}],"geoLocations":[],"fundingReferences":[],"xml":"","url":"https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22477","contentUrl":null,"metadataVersion":0,"schemaVersion":"http://datacite.org/schema/kernel-4","source":"mds","isActive":true,"state":"findable","reason":null,"viewCount":0,"viewsOverTime":[],"downloadCount":0,"downloadsOverTime":[],"referenceCount":0,"citationCount":0,"citationsOverTime":[],"partCount":0,"partOfCount":0,"versionCount":0,"versionOfCount":0,"created":"2025-10-28T03:16:18.000Z","registered":"2025-10-28T03:16:19.000Z","published":"2025","updated":"2025-10-28T03:16:19.000Z"},"relationships":{"client":{"data":{"id":"arxiv.content","type":"clients"}},"provider":{"data":{"id":"arxiv","type":"providers"}},"media":{"data":{"id":"10.48550/arxiv.2510.22477","type":"media"}},"references":{"data":[]},"citations":{"data":[]},"parts":{"data":[]},"partOf":{"data":[]},"versions":{"data":[]},"versionOf":{"data":[]}}}}
